A matriculate Ex-Serviceman with 15 years service in the Armed Forces will be considered eligible for posts for which graduation is prescribed, if work experience of technical or professional nature is not essential or if the appointing authority is satisfied that the Ex-Servicemen will perform the duties by undergoing on-the-job training for a short duration. - Order 3, Section 5.
